race.comment: Open race to close out the card. CLEARLY GEORGE (1) has a solid record over this distance range with three wins and three placings from 12 attempts and is drawn to get all the favours from the inside marble. Gets some well-needed weight relief with the claim and should be right there at the business end. BADDA BOOM BABY (7) was a touch disappointing last time out but go on the strong win over this course and distance two back. Watch for a spike in form. The well-related HOMERIC (2) (half to G3 winner Xidaki) has placed four from five over this trip and strips fitter third-up from the break. Include with Wiggins on top. WEEKEND SPIRIT (5) has been well in the betting at the past couple and where there's smoke there's fire. Keep very safe.
